scope: Portable contracts and prepared desktop browser mechanics; pending downstream platform/OS/accessibility/device qualification. No publication.

modules.descriptor: transient command presenter; no persisted descriptor
modules.keyboardFocus: Only local eligible triggers open the menu. Arrow keys choose, Enter admits one registered command/history group, Escape cancels and restores editor focus. Composition, nested controls and remote patches never trigger it.
modules.fallback: Factory absent: no slash trigger, document editing remains
unsupported: remote edits must not open menu

modules.keyboardFocus: Label and identifier remain inert offline. Keyboard explicit activation/query only through a host-granted resolver; Escape cancels. Retain engine anchors before menu focus; suppress revoked, stale or deleted-target results.
modules.fallback: Inert ID/label, no resolver call on opening

modules.descriptor: transient presenter; existing node identity and topology
modules.keyboardFocus: Every editable host exposes keyboard move up/down through the shared Move command, retaining identity and relative selection. Browser Alt+Arrow and focusable buttons restore editor focus; pointer handles are optional. Composition/nested controls take priority.
modules.fallback: Factory absent: reordered document remains readable

modules.keyboardFocus: Expose alt text and selectable inert source when no asset grant exists. No implicit upload or fetch. Source controls are nonediting; explicit host activation owns focus and permission. Authoring/resizing is not qualified.
modules.fallback: Alt/title/source retained; host asset policy required before URL activation

modules.keyboardFocus: Simple rectangular cell controls retain an engine target, use one atomic TableCell intent and undo group, and preserve navigation/selection. Nested cell composition owns temporary input. Unavailable controls expose nonediting exact source, never flatten cells.
modules.fallback: Exact edited tuple/source preserved without controls

modules.keyboardFocus: Keep bounded LaTeX source selectable and labeled when renderer is absent, unsafe, invalid or failed. Optional preview never captures baseline input. No dedicated math authoring UI or inferred native typesetting parity.
modules.fallback: LaTeX source label; absent/failed/unsafe renderer preserves source
